seo.description: Hike or drive viewpoints on Mount Gourougou near Nador: lagoon panoramas and Rif coastal views.

name: Mount Gourougou
hero_subtitle: A low mountain above Nador — trails and wide views over lagoon, coast and Melilla on clear days.

overview.title: Height over the lagoon city
overview.p1: Mount Gourougou (Gurugu) rises beside Nador and Melilla, offering short hikes and road viewpoints that put the lagoon and Mediterranean coast in one frame.
overview.p2: On clear days the view can stretch toward Melilla and the wider shoreline. Trails vary in difficulty; sturdy shoes and water are essential in warm months.
overview.p3: Go early to avoid heat. Combine with a relaxed corniche evening rather than stacking another long transfer the same day.

food.title: Food near Mount Gourougou
food.p1: Few restaurants sit on the mountain itself — plan a solid meal in Nador before or after your hike, and carry water and snacks on the trail.
food.li1: Eat in town or on the corniche before the climb.
food.li2: Pack nuts, fruit and plenty of water.
food.li3: Do not rely on mountain kiosks outside peak weekends.
food.li4: Return to lagoon-side seafood in the evening.
food.li5: Confirm any roadside café hours in advance.
food.p2: A picnic works well if you start early.

q1.question: Do I need a guide?
q1.answer: Not for every viewpoint; useful for longer trail routes.

q2.question: How hard is it?
q2.answer: Options range from easy viewpoints to steeper hikes — match the route to your fitness.

q3.question: Best season?
q3.answer: Spring and autumn for temperature and visibility.

q4.question: Can I drive up?
q4.answer: Some viewpoints are road-accessible; confirm current access locally.

q5.question: How long?
